name: Alternative Beach
description: is not a natural beach but an all-inclusive day club and hostel in the heart of Canggu, Bali, offering a pool, swim-up bar, cafe, and accommodation. It provides a beach club atmosphere with a large pool, sun loungers, a waterslide, DJs, cocktails, and both hostel and private room lodging on-site.
note: Weekly pool party every Saturday (or special event) and movie night every Monday & Thursday starting at 19:00.
priceRange: Entry / day-bed minimum spend from Rp 100.000 (entry)
